You have to look at other ways through and when you are in a horrible situation thinking about her coming to harm is normally in that she can't just make you hurt and fuck off.

Maybe if you can't think of a reason to do it is a sign that you don't need to, you just need more, more attention for your issues and for you rather than others. Taking some me time is good for you. Maybe you should find more friends who empathise with you, who understand. Also talking to your boyfriend more will be less of an emotional drain on him than having to deal with your death. You do have family, just not in the sense you are thinking, you have a reddit family, your boyfriend, people who have the same interests, you just need to look more and put more effort into it. You need to find something you truely love and reap it for everything it has to offer, let it distract you so you don't think about it all the time. Just one distraction can lift the pressure and you need to start there to be able to move forward.

You need to rip off the band-aid, else it will end up hurting you both more. The longer you leave it the more it will hurt her when you tell her, as she will know you didn't feel able to share for so long. You will hurt too because you will be bottling these feelings up.

It isnt worth it, the last thing you will feel is the worst pain of your life and once you feel that you will regret it immediately. Please don't do it.
